Files were downloaded unchanged from the publisher's `textures/download/`:

- `8k_jupiter.jpg`: actually 4096 × 2048 pixels despite the publisher's filename.
  SHA-256: `0bd844bf20822c4e3e80882b077859833c0dac44c7e4e1e0cd63d1b1b6d43085`
- `8k_moon.jpg`: 8192 × 4096 pixels.
  SHA-256: `d1875bcec83588ca25e4802e576f6bb9f88b39e1e403cb41ff55867419c54796`
- `8k_saturn_ring_alpha.png`: 8192 × 500 pixels, RGBA radial ring profile.
  SHA-256: `f1f826933c9ff87d64ecf0518d6256b8ed990b003722794f67e96e3d2b876ae4`

Project adaptations: Godot GPU compression/mipmaps and runtime shading, surface
rotation and atmospheric color treatment. Original image pixels are retained.
The fictional giant combines the Jupiter surface and Saturn ring profile; its
size, orbit and presentation are art direction, not an astronomical claim.

The publisher describes these as NASA-imagery-derived artistic maps, with tuned
colors and fictional filling of unmapped areas. Do not use as scientific data.
